title: Commissioners.
bodyText: If the court appoints commissioners pursuant to section 668-13, each commissioner, in addition to the requirements and disqualifications applicable to commissioners in section 668-13, shall be disinterested, impartial, and neither a party to nor a participant in the action.
bodyHtml: [§668A-5]  Commissioners.  If the court appoints commissioners pursuant to section 668-13, each commissioner, in addition to the requirements and disqualifications applicable to commissioners in section 668-13, shall be disinterested, impartial, and neither a party to nor a participant in the action. [L 2016, c 260, pt of §1]
